meta.objective: Patch the remaining score_gen batch-attempt timeout and observability gaps, validate, deploy, reset the V3 cohort to preflight_clean, then hand control back to the v3-finish-pass relaunch gate.

decisions.decision: Treat the current failed full-loop pass as the forensic baseline for the workflow.
decisions.reason: The cohort is already scientifically_invalid and fully explained enough to patch without another live probe.

decisions.decision: Do not accept a pure timeout increase as the primary fix.
decisions.reason: The score-stage preamble needs resumable continuation semantics rather than a larger single activity segment.

decisions.decision: Persist batch-preparation checkpoints on llm_batch_executions and resume from them on replay.
decisions.reason: This creates a durable continuation boundary before provider batch submission without introducing a new coordination table.

decisions.decision: Return the failed cohort to preflight_clean immediately after deploy and validation instead of relaunching inside this workflow.
decisions.reason: The goal of this deep workflow is closure of the active blocker and a clean relaunch gate for the next v3-finish-pass loop.
